description: Amendments of v4's state machines that the owner approved (ODR-V41-08, APR-V41-OWNER-2). v4 is frozen at tag indy-init-requirements-v4.0.0 and its files are never edited: requirements-compiler v41 applies each transition over the frozen machines when it compiles state-machine-contracts.json. Check X12 requires each transition and accepted entry to name a state-machine-amendment request and its operator approval, sources that are baseline requirements, and a fit with its machine (known states and events, deterministic guards, Saved entered only by a confirmation); the offline suite checks that the owner's selected option adds exactly these transitions. No state or event is added. Engine.Update (src/Causa.App/Engine.fs, ui) steps MutationSent in the same update that turns the mutation request into HostEffect.Http (IF41-SAVE, IF41-APP); because T-S61 changes nothing, a missing MutationSent changes no outcome, and no test beyond T-S61's state-machine test requires it. Option A's 'records the outstanding request' holds without an effect: the step that sends the mutation (T-S04, T-S14, T-S24, T-S26, T-S54) already records it as Outstanding, and T-S61's guard admits only that request. v4.1.2 (ODR-V412-01, ODR-V412-03): every reconciliation read of SM-SAVE, automatic or not, is sent only while fewer than four were sent in the 60 s before RequestContext.Now (INV-04): T-S31 and T-S32 are replaced and T-S62, T-S63 and T-S65 added for CheckAgain and WentOnline; T-S47 is replaced so it no longer promises a read on return; the automatic reads apply the same window in ReconcileDue (IF41-SAVE). T-S64 states the failed final automatic read (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-12). No state or event is added.

transitions.guard: current: its RequestId is the session's Outstanding request, which awaits MutationAnswer
effects: none: the state, the base head, Outstanding (RequestId, MutationAnswer) and the unsaved changes are unchanged; the event confirms that Engine.Update returned the HostEffect.Http of the outstanding createCommitOnBranch

effects: record its send time in ReconcileReadsSentAt

transitions.guard: automatic reads spent and four reconciliation reads already sent in the 60 s before RequestContext.Now
effects: announce that Check again can read again 60 s after the oldest of those four reads

transitions.guard: automatic reads spent and fewer than four reconciliation reads sent in the 60 s before RequestContext.Now
effects: record its send time in ReconcileReadsSentAt

effects: the automatic reads resume: the next is sent when due, under the 60 s window of ReconcileDue
on return, T-S32, T-S63 or T-S65 applies
no further automatic reads except one per offline-to-online change

accepted.note: SM-LOAD keeps no transport-failure event: a provider refusal, a transport failure or a lost answer during a load is LoadRejected carrying LoadFailure.ProviderFailed (IF41-SAVE), as the owner accepted. No transition is added.
